title: Proofs of Prophethood 8: The Moon Splitting
normalized_text: welcome to a new video in the proofs of prophethood series in this one i'm going to be talking about the moon splitting quick background the polytheists of makkah asked the prophet for a sign and then the moon started to split he then said to them bear witness now i've made a couple of videos about this in the past however has a different perspective of a subject i tend to argue that it was due to the lack of documentation that we do not have um non-islamic sources speaking about the moon splitting has a completely different theory argues that this was a miracle specifically for the people of makkah and not for anyone else the reasoning behind this is that if the moon was seen splitting in different regions of the world it would be used by false claimants to push their own agendas false prophets in different lands would claim that the moon split for them and of course imagine someone in rome or someone in china seeing the moon split how would they even tie that to the prophet peace be upon him now the prevention of people from witnessing the moon splitting in different regions of the world could have occurred through natural means like the weather perhaps even some other supernatural means now i know that some of you seem to believe that there was some sort of 7th century manuscript about an indian king witnessing the moon splitting however that is an unreliable manuscript it was written in arabic it's quite late it contains anachronisms so no that wouldn't be uh good evidence of that happening now back to abu jabbar he makes a very interesting claim he states that the prophet peace be upon him was extremely eager for people to follow him and his message that being said why would he make a claim like that why would he claim that the moon split wouldn't making a claim like that be the fastest way for people to rejecting your claim of prophethood now imagine you going up to the people of your city people of your town and saying to them i saw the moon split yesterday and now it's back now if you were someone who claimed prophethood wouldn't everyone just reject you so who would believe you if you said this and why didn't islam absolutely collapse when that happened how come why is it that more people ended up embracing islam after this claim also keep in mind that this is something that occurred when muslims were a minority in makkah i mean think about rationally if this is something that never happened islam should have collapsed immediately mentions multiple companions that have reported the moon splitting these include alibi and multiple others speaks about this in a sermon when he was in now why did the companions do this why did they preach this how come you don't have people calling them out as liars for saying this so why didn't the sahaba call each other out when this claim was made i mean the sahaba they would disagree on religious matters minute religious matters have to do with praying and fasting and ablution however you don't have them calling each other out on something as big as this what caused them to go around so casually speaking about this when it's something that never occurred the answer is a simple one it actually happened that's all i have for today i'll see you guys in the next one salaam alaiki a
